original_record.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Armoured Souls individual robot game portrait. Generate ONE square 1:1 image of ONE complete source-faithful robot, not an original substitute.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal-to-black industrial studio gradient, subtle dark floor and restrained low haze.
Style/medium: premium realistic industrial sci-fi hard-surface 3D rendering, believable metal, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, preserving source geometry and colours. Match the established Armoured Souls portrait collection.
Composition: three-quarter view, complete full body with head, all feet/legs and equipment contained in frame, centered at about 80% of square canvas with at least 5% clear margin around EVERY extremity. Readable silhouette at 512px.
Lighting: neutral soft key, cool upper-right rim light, controlled cinematic contrast and subtle source-appropriate sensors.
Constraints: one character, no additional figures, no collage/grid, no text/captions, watermark, UI or border, no firing or explosions. Keep canonical proportions and anatomy; do not add humanoid arms to walkers or astromechs. Full-resolution square master for 512x512 WebP export.

One compact short-range arena emitter on a source mount and the front plates represent one equipped shield. Other hardpoints empty. Whole shielded chassis and feet visible.

source_notes:
**Franchise:** War Robots  
**Strategy:** Squadron · **Target roster:** 6 robots  
**Opening:** 3 robots · **Hard cap:** 6 robots  
**Catalogue key:** `walking-war-foundry`

**Proposed robots:** Lancelot WR; Natasha; Fenrir; Griffin; Leo; Fujin.

**Source edition:** Standard base Lancelot, Natasha, Fenrir, Griffin, Leo, and Fujin designs. No Ultimate editions, special skins, or Titans.

**Naming:** Lancelot WR preserves the source alias Lancelot and avoids the already-authored Code Geass robot named Lancelot. The other five use source machine designations.

**Backstory:** The Foundry opens with a shielded spearhead, a ranged platform, and a stubborn brawler. Its second delivery completes a six-machine formation built to keep three pairs and two trios in work.

**Purchasing personality:** Griffin joins first to complete the second pair. Fund Leo and Fujin together before the final recruitment sequence; alternate later upgrades between the two trios.

**Robot blueprints**

| Slot | Arena robot name | Source identity | Joins | Arena role | Loadout | Stance / yield | Build_Focus |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Lancelot WR** | Lancelot | Opening | Frontline anchor | `weapon_shield` | defensive / 20% | Warden |
| 2 | **Natasha** | Natasha | Opening | Heavy ranged support | `two_handed` | offensive / 10% | Deadeye |
| 3 | **Fenrir** | Fenrir | Opening | Mid-range brawler | `two_handed` | balanced / 15% | Bruiser |
| 4 | **Griffin** | Griffin | Growth #1 | Mobile assault | `dual_wield` | offensive / 10% | Sprinter |
| 5 | **Leo** | Leo | Growth #2 | Durable fire support | `two_handed` | balanced / 15% | Bruiser |
| 6 | **Fujin** | Fujin | Growth #3 | Protected ranged anchor | `weapon_shield` | defensive / 25% | Tactician |

**Weapon paths** — stage 0 on recruitment, then stage 1. Prices are combined list-price equipment subtotals, not total robot or stable purchase costs.

| Slot | Range from weapons | Stage 0 | Stage 1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | short | Laser Pistol + Light Shield (₡108,000) | Volt Sabre + Aegis Bulwark (₡834,000) |
| 2 | long | Training Beam (₡50,000) | Ion Beam (₡544,000) |
| 3 | mid | Training Rifle (₡50,000) | Plasma Cannon (₡408,000) |
| 4 | short | Laser Pistol x2 (₡114,000) | Volt Sabre x2 (₡850,000) |
| 5 | mid | Training Rifle (₡50,000) | Plasma Cannon (₡408,000) |
| 6 | long | Beam Pistol + Combat Shield (₡171,000) | Particle Lance + Aegis Bulwark (₡834,000) |

**Equipment planning totals:** opening trio ₡208,000; recruits 4–6 at stage 0 ₡335,000; all six at stage 1 ₡3,878,000; 9 equipped weapon/shield items at the six-robot target. The stage-0 equipment component of the slot-5-and-6 recruitment reserve is ₡221,000, plus both robot frames, required facilities, and maintenance reserve.

**Refinement plans — after all six robots reach stage 1**

Execute each row from left to right. Costs and workshop gates for every operation are in the [shared refinement rules](#squadron-refinement-rules). Main/offhand targets are explicit; all six robots have a non-empty plan.

| Slot | Robot | Ordered refinement steps | Refinement subtotal |
|---|---|---|---:|
| 1 | **Lancelot WR** | Offhand Aegis Bulwark: Hone Evasion Thrusters −5→0 → Main Volt Sabre: Hone Combat Power 8→10 → Main Volt Sabre: Augment Adaptive AI +3 (new) → Main Volt Sabre: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Volt Sabre: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡1,170,000 |
| 2 | **Natasha** | Main Ion Beam: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Ion Beam: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡700,000 |
| 3 | **Fenrir** | Main Plasma Cannon: Hone Combat Power 7→10 → Main Plasma Cannon: Hone Critical Systems 6→10 → Main Plasma Cannon: Augment Hull Integrity +3 (new) → Main Plasma Cannon: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Plasma Cannon: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡1,130,000 |
| 4 | **Griffin** | Main Volt Sabre: Hone Attack Speed 4→7 → Main Volt Sabre: Augment Evasion Thrusters +2 (new) → Main Volt Sabre: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Volt Sabre: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡870,000 |
| 5 | **Leo** | Main Plasma Cannon: Hone Combat Power 7→10 → Main Plasma Cannon: Hone Critical Systems 6→10 → Main Plasma Cannon: Augment Hull Integrity +3 (new) → Main Plasma Cannon: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Plasma Cannon: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡1,130,000 |
| 6 | **Fujin** | Offhand Aegis Bulwark: Hone Evasion Thrusters −5→0 → Main Particle Lance: Hone Targeting Systems 8→10 → Main Particle Lance: Augment Weapon Control +3 (new) → Main Particle Lance: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Particle Lance: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡1,170,000 |

**Refinement budget:** ₡6,170,000 across six robots. Final stage-1 equipment plus refinement totals ₡10,048,000; stage-0 purchases and facility, frame, training, and maintenance costs are additional.

**Portrait blueprints** — show one complete body using the shared art direction. Signature features identify the source; every active weapon or shield must map to the equipment allocations above.

| Slot | Portrait and equipment brief |
|---|---|
| 1 | Standard Lancelot armour, broad torso, and recognizable shielded front. Source silhouette with one short-range weapon and one equipped shield; the visual plates add no separate armour buff. |
| 2 | Standard Natasha walking chassis and source weapon-mount arrangement. Represent one heavy long-range arena weapon, keeping every limb and the entire barrel inside the portrait. |
| 3 | Use the standard Fenrir body and source armour shapes, not a special skin. One heavy mid-range weapon; choose one stationary pose without duplicating transformed configurations. |
| 4 | Preserve Griffin legs, torso, and recognizable jump assembly. Two short-range weapons occupy main and offhand allocations; jumping remains visual flavour. |
| 5 | Standard Leo frame, sturdy legs, and heavy weapon silhouette. One mid-range two-handed allocation; source hardpoint counts do not create additional arena weapon slots. |
| 6 | Keep Fujin quadrupedal construction and its elevated weapon body. One long-range weapon and one shield allocation; retain the source shield impression without extra free abilities. |

**Named teams and fixed membership** — all names are original Armoured Souls team labels.

| Format | Team name | Fixed members | Forms |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2v2 | **Steel Vow** | 1 Lancelot WR + 2 Natasha | Opening trio |
| 2v2 | **Thunder March** | 3 Fenrir + 4 Griffin | When slot 4 joins |
| 2v2 | **Iron Horizon** | 5 Leo + 6 Fujin | When slot 6 joins |
| 3v3 | **Foundry Vanguard** | 1 Lancelot WR + 2 Natasha + 3 Fenrir | Opening trio |
| 3v3 | **Walking Thunder** | 4 Griffin + 5 Leo + 6 Fujin | When slot 6 joins |

**Shared parameters:** apply the Squadron recruitment, fixed-team, event-order, budget, tuning, refinement, and image rules below. Slots 1–3 open together; buy 4, then 5, then 6. No reserve slots or substitution alternatives are included.

References: [Lancelot](https://warrobots.com/en/robots/21), [Natasha](https://warrobots.com/en/robots/25), [Fenrir](https://warrobots.com/en/robots/54), [Griffin](https://warrobots.com/en/robots/24), [official Leo, Griffin, and Fujin media](https://warrobots.com/en/media/40).
purchasing_plan: Open with slots 1–3. Recruit slot 4, then fund the complete slot-5/slot-6 pair before buying 5 followed by 6. Finish all six final loadouts before refinement. Invest in slot order 1,4,2,5,3,6, with Hone, Augment, first Sharpen and first Forge passes through Workshop L1, L3, L5 and L8. Keep funding and prestige-gated steps pending.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, upkeep, repair costs, discounts and resale. Alternatives excluded.
